blocks.text: Proposition 2.4. Let X be an ordered normed vector space and let S ⊆ X+. The following are equivalent: (i) The set S determines positivity of functionals in the sense that, for each x′ ∈ X′, the inequality x′,x ≥ 0 for all x ∈ S implies that x′ ≥ 0. (ii) The positive-linear hull of S is weakly dense (equivalently, norm dense) in X+. If the cone V+ in an ordered vector space X has a base D, then x ∈ D is extremal if and only if x is an extreme point of D, see [6, Lemma 1.5.19]. The following result by Krein and Milman is given, e.g., in [13, §II.10.5 on p.68].
Proposition 2.5. Let V be a locally convex Hausdorﬀ space. Let Σ ⊆ V be compact and convex and let S′ ⊆ Σ. If Σ = conv(S′) then ext Σ ⊆ S′.

Proposition 2.2. Let V = {0} be an ordered normed space whose cone has an interior point v. Then v is an order unit and the order unit norm   · v is weaker than the original norm   ·  on V . Moreover, every positive functional on V is continuous with respect to both norms. Note that the two norms in Proposition 2.2 need not be equivalent, see, e.g., [6, Example 1.5.12].
